title: Cleaning With Quarantine Discipline
objective: After this lesson you will be able to handle missing values deliberately (per-column policies), dedupe on declared keys with provenance, parse dates/currency strictly with quarantine for failures, and report reject rates per rule.
why: Cleaning decisions corrupt silently at scale: mean-imputed prices bias revenue, dropped NaN keys vanish rows, dedupe-without-keys deletes distinct orders, locale-guessed dates shift quarters. Each rule needs a stated policy plus a quarantine stream carrying rejects with reasons — the OpenDataLoader discipline, executed in pandas.

blocks.text: Missing values: policy per column, never global

Each column gets an explicit rule: **drop** (unusable key fields), **fill with stated value** (0 for counts, 'unknown' for segments — never means), **median/mode impute** (only for modeling features, flagged as imputed), or **quarantine** (unparseable criticals). Global `fillna(0)` corrupts meanings indiscriminately — policy per column, recorded with the rule.

blocks.code:
import pandas as pd
from io import StringIO
csv = "id,price,qty\n1,129.00,2\n2,,1\n3,59.50,\n"
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(csv))
quarantine = df[df["price"].isna()][["id"]].assign(reason="missing-price")
df = df.dropna(subset=["price"]).copy()
df["qty"] = df["qty"].fillna(1).astype(int)  # stated: single-unit default
print("kept:", len(df), "quarantined:", len(quarantine))
print("revenue:", float((df["price"] * df["qty"]).sum()))

blocks.text: Duplicates resolve on **declared keys** (`order_id`), keeping first/last by stated rule and logging merged-from IDs — never full-row equality (formatting differences hide true dupes) and never silent drops (counts reconcile: raw = kept + quarantined). Unkeyed 'looks duplicate' deletions destroy evidence.

blocks.code:
import pandas as pd
from io import StringIO
csv = "order_id,total\nA1,100\nA1,100\nA2,50\n"
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(csv), dtype={"order_id": str})
dupes = df[df.duplicated("order_id", keep=False)]
print("dup rows:", len(dupes))
clean = df.drop_duplicates("order_id", keep="first")
print("kept:", len(clean), "total:", float(clean["total"].sum()))

blocks.text: Parse with `format=` (strict, no guessing), `errors` routed to quarantine (never `coerce`-and-forget without counting), currency stripped of symbols then converted with failure quarantine. Timezones normalized to UTC on ingest; locale day-first/month-first stated per source after sampling — never guessed per row.

blocks.title: Quarantine the rows
blocks.note: Run it: expect kept 2, quarantined 1 (missing-price), revenue 317.5 (129×2 + 59.5×1 default). Policy twins: drop-criticals, default-counts, quarantine-with-reasons — same discipline, both languages.

items: Per-column missing policies (drop/fill-flagged/quarantine) — never global fillna
Key-based dedupe with provenance; counts reconcile raw = kept + quarantined
Strict date/currency parsing with failure quarantine; UTC normalization on ingest

exercise.prompt: (a) Run the practice cleaner and verify kept/reasons/revenue. (b) In Python (your env), replicate on a 5-row CSV with one missing price and one duplicate key; report kept/quarantined/revenue. (c) State the imputation rule for a modeling feature vs a revenue figure, with the flagging requirement.
hints: Twin outputs: kept 2, missing-price ×1, revenue 317.5 (qty default 1 applied once).
Python: dropna(subset) + quarantine frame + fillna-with-comment; duplicated(key) + drop_duplicates keep-first with merged log.
Modeling features: median-impute WITH _was_missing flag; revenue figures: never impute (quarantine) — money needs truth, models need completeness.
exercise.why: Twin parity (JS logic mirrors pandas), per-rule quarantine (reasons + counts), and imputation-vs-truth judgment (flagged vs never) are the three cleaning disciplines.
exercise.code: # Cleaning pattern: rule per column + quarantine frames + reconciled counts.

quiz.q: Global fillna(0) on a revenue table. Verdict?
options: Corrupting: missing prices become $0 sales — per-column policies (quarantine criticals, flag imputations)
quiz.explain: Blanket fills fabricate money: $0 sales distort revenue and averages. Criticals quarantine; features impute flagged.

quiz.q: Duplicate order_ids with identical totals. Action?
options: Dedupe on the key keeping first with merged-from log — duplicates double revenue silently
quiz.explain: Key-based dedupe with provenance: identical totals still double-count. Counts reconcile raw = kept + quarantined.

quiz.q: Day-first vs month-first dates in one file. Approach?
options: Sample to establish corpus convention, parse strictly with format=, quarantine failures — stated policy, never per-row guessing
quiz.explain: Locale ambiguity resolves by documented convention from samples, enforced strictly, with quarantine for violators.

summary: Per-column missing policies, keyed dedupe with provenance, strict date/currency parsing, quarantine with reasons, reconciled counts. Cleaning as engineering discipline.
